description: Device info request (function 0x01 read, command 0x01) with the sum8 checksum. Sent by the EnerKey/NEEY app to EK-24S4EB ZH-1.2.9 and ZH-2.0.8 and answered by GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 as well. Answer: 100-byte device info frame.

Settings request (command 0x04), sum8. Answer: settings frame (100 bytes on NEEY_V1, 150 bytes on NEEY_V2). In the captures the balancer starts streaming cell info frames about every 0.5 s after this request.
Cell info request (command 0x02), sum8, length field in the normal position. Answer: 300-byte cell info frame (the stream continues without further requests).

source: https://github.com/syssi/esphome-jk-bms/blob/main/components/heltec_balancer_ble/button/__init__.py BUTTONS retrieve_factory_defaults (0x03); built with the documented layout
description: Factory defaults (calibration data) request (command 0x03) with the sum8 checksum. Only the XOR variant was captured (tx-factory-defaults-xor-app).

Device info request as sent by the NEEY Android app (V3.1) to GW-24S4EB HW-2.8.0 SW-1.1.0: XOR checksum (0xFA) instead of sum8 (0x26). GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 answered both checksums; EK-24S4EB firmware answers only sum8 (spec 3.4). Drivers send tx-device-info.
Settings request as sent by the NEEY Android app to GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0 (XOR checksum 0xFF).

Cell info request as sent by the NEEY Android app to GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0: the length bytes are swapped (00 14 instead of 14 00) and the checksum is XOR. GW firmware answers it; EK-24S4EB does not answer this form (spec 3.4). Drivers send tx-cell-info.
Factory defaults request with the XOR checksum, answered by GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 with a 20-byte echo frame and two 100-byte factory frames.

Balancer switch on: function 0x00 (write), command 0x05, register 0x0D, u32 LE value 1, sum8. Captured from the EnerKey app talking to EK-24S4EB ZH-1.2.9; the balancer echoes the frame (with 55 AA) and sends a fresh settings frame.
Balancer switch off: register 0x0D, value 0, sum8 (EK-24S4EB ZH-1.2.9 capture).
Balancer switch on as sent by the NEEY app to GW-24S4EB (XOR checksum 0xF3).
Balancer switch off as sent by the NEEY app to GW-24S4EB (XOR checksum 0xF2).

Balance trigger delta voltage write: register 0x02, IEEE 754 float32 LE in volts (0.008 V), XOR checksum, NEEY app to GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0. The balancer answers with a 20-byte acknowledge (rx-gw-sw110-ack-trigger-delta).

Balance trigger delta voltage write: register 0x02, IEEE 754 float32 LE in volts (0.004 V), XOR checksum, NEEY app to GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0. The balancer answers with a 20-byte acknowledge (rx-gw-sw110-ack-trigger-delta).

Balance trigger delta voltage write: register 0x02, IEEE 754 float32 LE in volts (0.002 V), XOR checksum, NEEY app to GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0. The balancer answers with a 20-byte acknowledge (rx-gw-sw110-ack-trigger-delta).
Maximum balance current write: register 0x03, float32 LE in amperes (4.0 A), XOR checksum (GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0).
Maximum balance current write: register 0x03, float32 LE in amperes (2.0 A), XOR checksum (GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0).
Maximum balance current write: register 0x03, float32 LE in amperes (1.0 A), XOR checksum (GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0).
Maximum balance current 2.5 A (register 0x03, float32), XOR, from the NEEY app capture of GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3.
Maximum balance current 3.4 A (register 0x03, float32 0x4059999A), XOR, GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 capture.
Balancing stop (sleep) voltage 2.3 V: register 0x04, float32, XOR, GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 capture.
Balancing start (equalization) voltage 2.5 V: register 0x17, float32, XOR, GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 capture.
Nominal battery capacity 300 Ah: register 0x16, u32 LE integer (not a float), XOR (GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0).
Nominal battery capacity 200 Ah: register 0x16, u32 LE integer (not a float), XOR (GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0).
Nominal battery capacity 280 Ah: register 0x16, u32 LE integer (not a float), XOR (GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0).
Cell count write as listed in the [SY] table of app commands (register 0x01, u32 integer 1, XOR). Not a device capture; no captured cell count write exists.
Buzzer mode write from the [SY] app command table (register 0x14, u32 1 = off; 2 = beep once, 3 = beep regular). Not a device capture.
Battery type write from the [SY] app command table (register 0x15, u32 2 = LFP; 1 NCM, 3 LTO, 4 PbAc). Not a device capture.
Device name write from the [SY] app command table (register 0x13, ASCII "test" in bytes 8..17, at most 10 characters). Not a device capture.

GW-24S4EB HW-2.8.0 SW-1.1.0 protocol V1.0.0 device info frame (100 bytes). Bytes 64..97 are zero on this firmware.
GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0 settings frame (100 bytes) read before the app switched the balancer on: offset 21 = 0.
Same unit after register 0x0D was written with 1: offset 21 = 1, all other values unchanged. Start voltage reads 0.0 V on this firmware.
16-cell cell info frame while balancing (status 0x05) with a positive balance current (energy flowing into the lowest cell). Frame statistics at 205/209/213/214 agree with the cell voltages.
First streamed cell info frame after the settings request, before any cell info request: status 0x04 (self test completed), balancer switched off, balance current 0.
Write acknowledge from GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0 for register 0x0D: function 0x00, command 0x05, register echoed, value bytes zero (not echoed), sum8 0x36. Identical for value 0 and 1.
Write acknowledge for register 0x02 (value not echoed).
Write acknowledge for register 0x03.
Write acknowledge for register 0x16.
GW-24S4EB HW-2.8.0 ZH-1.2.3 V1.0.0 device info frame, the answer to the sum8 request tx-device-info (2022 log).
Same unit, later device info frame: power-on count 8, runtime 778742 s.
Another GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 (production date 20220916) queried with the sum8 requests in 2024.
20-byte frame sent first in answer to the factory defaults request: function 0x01, command 0x03, length 0x14, zero data, sum8 0x28. Two 100-byte factory frames follow.

Factory defaults frame (command 0x03, 100 bytes) of GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3: float32 calibration constants, power-on counter, runtime and production date. Field names come from the app; meanings unverified.
Second factory frame of the same answer: live-looking values differ slightly (standard voltage 1, battery voltage 1, standard current 1, SuperBat 1), constants are identical.
GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 settings frame: 16 cells, trigger 0.005 V, 4 A, sleep 2.5 V, balancer on, buzzer off, LFP, 280 Ah, start 2.6 V.
Same unit after switching the balancer off with register 0x0D: offset 21 = 0, checksum 0xB6.
GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 cell info frame while balancing with a negative balance current (energy taken from the highest cell). Temperatures 50.24 degC.
Balancing frame with +4.003 A (charging the lowest cell); the frames around it alternate between positive and negative balance current.
Status 0x04 frame with several cells at the maximum voltage: offset 213 holds the last cell with that voltage (0-based 15), while a first-occurrence search gives cell 11.
Second GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.3 (2024): status 0x04 and cell detection failed bitmask 0xFF0000 (bits for slots 17..24, which are not connected).
GW-24S4EB HW-3.2.0 ZH-1.2.4 protocol V1.0.0 ("4th generation") device info frame, transcribed by hand in the issue; length, end marker and sum8 verified.
GW-24S4EB ZH-1.2.4 settings frame (hand transcription, sum8 verified): 3.5 A, sleep 3.35 V, balancer off, 350 Ah, start 3.37 V.
EK-24S4EB HW-3.2.0 ZH-1.2.9 protocol V1.2.9 device info frame. Bytes 64..81 hold an ASCII identifier: the BLE address 3C:A5:51:95:7D:90 as hex digits followed by "123456".
EK-24S4EB ZH-1.2.9 settings frame with the balancer on.
Settings frame sent by EK-24S4EB ZH-1.2.9 on its own right after the acknowledge of the register 0x0D = 0 write: offset 21 = 0.
Write acknowledge of EK-24S4EB ZH-1.2.9 for register 0x0D = 0. This firmware echoes the request bytes 3..17 (value included) with the 55 AA header.
Write acknowledge for register 0x0D = 1: the value 01 00 00 00 is echoed (GW-24S4EB SW-1.1.0 sends zeros instead).
EK-24S4EB ZH-1.2.9 cell info frame while balancing: -4.09 A, both temperatures 56.51 degC. Cells 3 and 8 share the maximum voltage; offset 213 reports the last one (index 7).
Cell info frame after the balancer was switched off: status 0x04, balance current 0.

EK-24S4EB ZH-2.1.1 cell info frame: status 0x0A, detection bitmask 0xFE0000. Byte 137 is 0xFF inside a resistance float, so the end marker alone must not terminate a frame.

EK-24S10EB settings frame: trigger 0.02 V, 8 A, sleep 3.35 V, buzzer mode 2 (beep once), start 3.42 V, stop delta 0.003 V.
EK-24S10EB cell info frame: status 0x0A, 16.07 degC.
EK-16S2EB cell info frame with 15 connected cells while balancing (-2.499 A). Byte 215 still reads 0x0F, so it is not the cell count.
EK-B24S8E200A HW-2.0.0 SW-2.0.0 protocol V1.3.36 device info frame. Offset 64: identifier with the reversed BLE address 33:39:04:01:05:44; offset 82: "EK-24S200A", the name the unit advertises.
Same unit, later device info frame (runtime 184243 s).

NEEY_V2 settings frame (150 bytes): balancer parameters plus BMS protection limits (float32 limits, u16 delays). float22 and float26 are labelled sleep voltage and start voltage by [SY] (unverified); offset 128 is the balancer switch (rx-v2-settings-balancer-off), offsets 126, 127 and 129 are unknown.
Second NEEY_V2 settings capture with different limits (charge OCP 100 A, stop/start 3.25/3.15 V). Balancer switch at offset 128 = 1.

Settings frame sent on its own after the register 0x0D = 0 acknowledge: only offset 128 changed (1 to 0) and the checksum. This places the balancer switch at offset 128, not at 126 as [SY] decodes it.
NEEY_V2 write acknowledge for register 0x0D = 0 (command 0x05, same as NEEY_V1).
NEEY_V2 write acknowledge for register 0x0D = 1 with the value echoed.

NEEY_V2 cell info frame: same layout as NEEY_V1 up to offset 216, then byte 217 (0x02), balance current at 218, pack current at 222, four temperatures, capacity, remaining capacity and SOC as float32, bitmasks from 266 and uptime at 291.

NEEY_V2 frame with +18.03 A pack current while balancing (-7.95 A). Remaining capacity rises from 267.382 Ah here to 267.549 Ah 34 s later (rx-v2-cell-info-switched-off), so positive current means charging.
Frame right after the balancer was switched off: status 0x04, balance current 0; uptime advanced by 34 s.
NEEY_V2 frame at 100 % SOC (remaining = capacity = 320 Ah) with status 0x0A.
EK-24S4EB ZH-2.1.1 cell info frame as two 150-byte notifications: the balancer sends an Exchange MTU Request of 153 bytes itself on this firmware. Streamed after the settings request, status 0x0A.

description: JK device info request (0x97) that the JK drivers write to FFE1 as their probe. It starts with AA 55 like a NEEY request but carries 0x90 at byte 2 and its checksum at byte 19 (no 0xFF end marker). Whether a NEEY unit ignores it was never tested (unverified); the EK firmware ignores requests that fail its checks (spec 11.3).
